title: Onchain research report (plain TypeScript)
summary: Answers a question from a CLOSED corpus: sources you supply plus onchain reads made through the Sato Kit's chain.read, each read becoming a source that carries the exact value and block. A model proposes findings; a deterministic gate refuses any that cite a source outside the corpus or contain a number no cited source contains, and keeps every refusal visible with its reason. Attributable, which is a narrower claim than true. Fixture mode uses a fake provider and recorded reads, with no network and no key. It holds no key, signs nothing and moves no funds.

tests.description: The platform runs the fixture command over the shipped scenarios with the FAKE provider and recorded RPC answers (no network, no key) and checks out/report.json against schemas/output.json. Evidence is labelled provider='fake' and is never a model evaluation.
The template's own tests. Recorded, never the verdict.

provenance.notes: model_policy.evaluated is empty: the candidates are configured choices, not evidence of compatibility with this template. Deterministic over fixtures; fork and rpc modes and the real provider are opt-in and never run in the platform's offline test phase.
